title: The King's Barrow
text: The greatest barrow of all is a hill raised over a king. Its door was sealed with his seal in black wax as big as a shield, and the seal is broken. Cold air pours out of the gap, carrying a smell of old gold and newer blood.

options.label: Go into the king's barrow and see what the robbers woke.

outcomes.text: Robbers came before you and woke what slept inside. It is still awake and still angry, among the treasure they could not carry.

options.label: The sharpest follows the robbers' tracks to take back what they stole.

outcomes.text: The tracks lead to their camp, where the king's crown sits by the fire. The robbers are not glad to see you.

options.label: Reseal the king's door and let him rest as he was meant to.

outcomes.text: The king thanks you in a dream, his hand cold and strong upon your shoulder.
